messages:
sam: FYI: we're running a preemptible eviction resilience dry-run in eu-central-1 next Wed 23:00-01:00 CET. Goal: validate autoscale + fallback routing for spot interruptions.

lee: Which fleets are in-scope? need to check Dedicated vs Hosted routing rules.

sam: In-scope: inference-runtime-pool, edge-routers in eu-c, and the kvcache pods that live on the same racks. Not in-scope: control-plane dbs and telemetry ingestion (we'll drain edges only).

ops-bot: scheduled_test created: preemptible-eviction-dryrun-euc-1912349999. Test window: 2026-04-01 22:45-01:15 CET. Canary run at 22:30 CET. Docs: https://internal/ops/tests/1912349999

emily: TL;DR on SLOs: we'll temporarily raise acceptable p99 latency to 2x baseline for the window and mute the automated pager for inference-error-rate alerts (errors still logged). Oncall will monitor and can un-mute if needed.

priya: Abort/stop criteria?

sam: Abort if request errors > 0.8% sustained for 10m OR if tail latency > 400ms sustained 7m, OR if traffic drops > 10% unexpectedly. Also abort if cache-miss rate spikes > 3x baseline for 10m.

lee: Can we script automatic reroute to fallback-quant for impacted traffic? I can add a temporary route policy in traffic-router: weight fallback-quant=100 when alarm state active.

priya: Nice. Add a flag to avoid evicting any dedicated-reserved nodes (we mustn't hit Dedicated pools).

sam: Confirmed — test will only target preemptible labels: node.kubernetes.io/instance-lifecycle=spot. Dedicated pools have node label reserved=dedicated and will be excluded.

devon: Canary load: synthetic chat + embeddings mix to mimic production. Command to run locally:

```
# run mix load against canary pool
./tools/loadctl run --target https://canary.euc1.infer.internal/mix --rps 120 --duration 900 --mix-spec tests/mix_specs/ratio_chat_emb.json
```

ops-bot: canary_execution started: 22:30 CET. Canary RPS 120. Synthetic user ids pinned to test namespace.

emily: I'll set temporary dashboards and turn down notification noise. Oncall @priya from 22:15-02:00 CET. Priya, you'll be primary for abort decisions.

priya: Got it. I'll post to #incidents if we hit abort criteria and escalate to PD as needed. Also will coordinate with capacity team for any immediate re-warms.

sam: Cache warm recommendation: run rd-cache-warm for the core_prompt keyset immediately after each spot rack drain: `rd-cache-warm --region euc1 --keyset core_prompt --replicas 2`

lee: Note: edge router connection churn may cause brief TLS handshakes to spike CPU on control-plane proxies. We've increased proxy connection pool thresholds for the window.

devon: I'll monitor request routing success with this quick query: `kubectl logs -l app=traffic-router -c router --since=15m | grep "route=fallback-quant" | wc -l`

sam: Post-test: collect KV shard distribution + cache hit ratios, and run a regression eval on a sample prompt set to verify quality didn't regress when routing to fallback-quant.

ops-bot: test_complete scheduled: collect-metrics job queued. Results page: https://internal/ops/tests/1912349999/results (will be populated after run).

emily: Thanks all — please ack if you see config pages where you need more perms or route definitions. I'll push the temporary SLO mute config to infra at 21:30 CET. :lock:
